# Vendored @smogon/calc (Champions-capable)

npm `@smogon/calc@0.11.0` (2026-03-11) lacks Champions (no gen 0).
This is a build of `calc/` from github.com/smogon/damage-calc@5d5bf4323990a32d2099ebd7fb50fec06ad2b501

Rebuild: sparse-clone damage-calc, `cd calc && npm i --ignore-scripts && npx tsc -p .`, copy dist+package.json (strip scripts) here.
